def duration_to_seconds(duration)
  raise ArgumentError, "duration must be a string" unless duration.is_a?(String)

  seconds_per_unit = { "h" => 3_600, "m" => 60, "s" => 1 }
  total_seconds = 0
  position = 0

  duration.scan(/\G(\d+)([hms])/).each do |amount, unit|
    total_seconds += amount.to_i * seconds_per_unit.fetch(unit)
    position += amount.length + 1
  end

  unless position == duration.length && position.positive?
    raise ArgumentError, "invalid duration: #{duration.inspect}"
  end

  total_seconds
end
